first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A yellow low-slung sports car in the foreground, with a dark rear panel, a large red rear wing, and four red ring-shaped taillights.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: A white low-slung sports car traveling ahead of Vehicle A, with a dark horizontal component and red points of light at the rear.

entities.name: racetrack surface
entities.identification: The gray paved surface extending from the foreground toward the gantry and the orange-lit entrance.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The low-texture blue-gray sky above the tree canopy, brighter near the horizon.

entities.name: orange-lit tunnel entrance
entities.identification: The arched orange-yellow illuminated entrance area among the trees behind the gantry.

entities.name: exhaust flame
entities.identification: The blue-white, pale blue, and orange ball of flame that appears briefly at the exhaust pipe on the image-left side of Vehicle A.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The curb with alternating red-and-white sections extending along the left edge of the racetrack.

entities.name: concrete racetrack barrier
entities.identification: The continuous gray wall along the left side of the racetrack and the lower wall farther away on the right.

entities.name: metal racetrack guardrail
entities.identification: The silver-gray guardrail composed of parallel horizontal slats on the image-right side at the beginning of the clip.

entities.name: racetrack safety fence
entities.identification: The mesh fence supported by repeated tall gray posts above the top of the wall on the left.

entities.name: trees around the outside of the racetrack
entities.identification: The dense dark green trees on both sides of the road and in the distance, with canopy heights that vary.

entities.name: racetrack sign and display screen
entities.identification: The discernible portion in this clip consists mainly of two columns of stacked rectangular advertising signs on the left and right of the gantry.

entities.name: roadside lattice tower
entities.identification: The slender gray lattice tower exposed behind the tree canopy in the upper right, with multiple levels of horizontal components near its top.

entities.name: gantry spanning the racetrack
entities.identification: The dark, long crossbeam structure spanning the racetrack in the distance, with light-colored text and logos on its front.

entities.name: roadside grass
entities.identification: The low green strip of grass between the outside of the left curb and the barrier.
